question: The rulers of which of the following dynasties built the Khajuraho temples between 950 to 1050 A.D in the central India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandela Dynasty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Chandel Kings built the Khajuraho temples.
 
• The temples at Khajuraho belong to two different religions Hinduism and Jainism.
 
• Chandella dynasty ruled the region in the 10th and 11th centuries CE.
